priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P1] Restore message-listener removal in the disposer
findings.body: Calling the returned function no longer invokes socket.off, so the handler continues receiving messages after teardown. Repeated attachments accumulate stale callbacks and retained references, causing duplicate processing and memory leaks.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head 68e4bf3, src/socket.ts:3 still returns an empty disposer; the base version called socket.off("message", handler). Thus invoking cleanup leaves the callback registered, so it continues receiving messages and repeated attach/cleanup cycles accumulate listeners.
